title: A Gentleman in Moscow
author: Amor Towles
summary: After the Russian Revolution, a Count is sentenced to house arrest in the grand Metropol Hotel, across the street from the Kremlin. As the decades pass, he builds a surprisingly full life within its walls.
readIf: you like elegant, comic, civilised novels with a charming lead and a warm sense of community.
skipIf: you want fast plotting; the pleasure is in digressions, manners and detail.

pairings.reason: The same author's later novel, another ensemble tale told with a similar love of language and a road in place of a hotel.
Also centres on a dignified man in a grand building watching history pass by, though with deeper regret.
Another aristocrat confined by circumstance, in a much more melodramatic and revenge-driven classic.
